statement: Write a PRD for a one-page website for Brew Lab, a small specialty coffee shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, where visitors see the menu with prices, opening hours and location, and can pre-order a coffee for pickup. The HLD, LLD and website follow from it.
users: Coffee lovers and office staff nearby
problem: People cannot see the menu or order ahead.
features: Pre-order form (name, phone, items, pickup time) emailed to hello@brewlab.example

user_groups.name: Coffee lovers
actions: Pre-order a coffee for pickup and pay at pickup

user_groups.name: Office staff nearby
actions: Pre-order a coffee for pickup and pay at pickup

constraints: No online payment, customers pay at pickup
facts: Monday to Saturday 7:30 am to 9:00 pm
name, phone, items and pickup time
No online payment, they pay at pickup
standards: The PRD is a markdown document
Written in the order PRD, HLD, LLD, each from the one before
rules: Use only facts from the brief; never invent facts
done_when: The Problem section states that people cannot see the menu or order ahead
The Users section names coffee lovers and office staff nearby and what each does
The Goals section states the aim of a one-page site for menu, hours, location and pre-orders

The Requirements section lists the menu with all 7 items and prices, the pre-order form fields (name, phone, items, pickup time) emailed to hello@brewlab.example, the address, both sets of opening hours, and the phone and email
The Success metrics section states 30 pre-orders per week
The Out of scope section states no online payment and no pages beyond one
